From: Nadia Flores, Digital Services
Subject: Preview our redesigned website

Please use the sample customer details provided in the instructions rather than your own information. The preview site is not connected to our reservation database, so any bookings you make there will not create real reservations. After completing the tasks, please fill out the online questionnaire. We are particularly interested in [141] ____ easily you can compare different travel dates. You do not need to report minor spelling errors, as our editorial team is already reviewing the text. We would appreciate receiving your responses by Friday afternoon so that the development team has sufficient time to [142] ____ the suggested improvements.
